elements.name: wide night view of a busy avenue
pavements packed with people as dark shapes
tall concrete buildings with many lit windows
one young man seen from behind at the roadside
young man small in the lower part of the frame

anatomy: The character is duplicated: two near-identical young men stand side by side, and only the left one wears the backpack.
notes: Remove the second, backpack-less twin. Keep one young man with the olive backpack, and paint him smaller in the lower centre so the avenue dominates the frame.
